probe: pinned /api/assets get, delete and character routes

conventions.fixedMtimes: every seeded file has mtime 1700000000 (whole seconds) so no recorded value depends on host mtime precision
conventions.paths: snapshot paths use forward slashes and are sorted; responses whose order comes from readdir are normalised by sorting arrays and object keys before recording

compared: steps[].response.body (normalised: arrays and object keys sorted)
deleted files (absence from the next snapshot)
shape: response.body order (readdir order is host-dependent; the sorted set is compared instead)

shapeReason.response.body order: the pinned routes build their arrays in readdir order, which differs between NTFS and ext4; the fixture records the sorted set and the replay compares the sorted set, so order is not asserted

shapeReason.etag: the ETag is computed over the raw response bytes, which contain host-dependent path separators for live2d character listings
